questions.text: How should a 'weak topic' be defined for the Strengths / weak topics list?
questions.reason: REQ-436 lists this as an open question; the definition decides what the dashboard shows.
questions.answer: Any topic with an average score below 60% across completed interviews.

questions.text: How is the 'progress trend' calculated (for example, change between consecutive completed interviews, or a moving average over the last N)?
questions.reason: REQ-436 lists this as an open question; it decides the trend data the API must return.
questions.answer: Calculate the score difference between the two most recent completed interviews. Show improvement, decline, or no change.

questions.text: How many completed sessions are needed before the average score is shown?
questions.reason: REQ-436 lists this as an open question; it sets the threshold for the average score card.
questions.answer: 2 completed interviews before showing the average score.
